objective: Eight mutually distinct falsifiable owner research studies; source-first existing evidence, then new original PIT and after-cost admission only if actually qualified.
source_readback_semantics: Eight independent connected GitHub source reads on 2026-11-07; historical PR and Actions runs are REUSED_NOT_NEW; no independently invoked AI agent.

lanes.name: Historical original PIT and source-first-known admission
lanes.question: Are original R1 forecast inputs lawful at issue-time across all 11 original cases?
lanes.hypothesis: All original field vintages, issue and publication clocks can be authenticated.
lanes.baseline: Same-clock prior-close, missing/no-forecast and original R1 admission null.
lanes.falsifier: Any missing original provider first-publication or independent event-family proof blocks admission.

lanes.question: Does Official forward sign beat same-issue persistence rather than reproduce present direction?
lanes.hypothesis: Original Official timing changes predict mature future 12H outcomes prospectively.
lanes.baseline: Same-clock preceding market direction and always-ABSTAIN.
lanes.falsifier: Identical sign and equal accuracy to persistence refute incremental sign skill; unjoined 72/168H are UNKNOWN.

lanes.falsifier: Individual M1 C2 becomes null or lead disappears at legal delivery clock.

lanes.falsifier: No improvement or one dependent 28d family rules out selection or promotion.

lanes.name: Breadth and ETF information after price and release latency
lanes.question: Do external ETF and breadth sensors add incremental predictive decision value?
lanes.hypothesis: Matched price/vol and legally delayed ETF/breadth inputs improve cluster-scored outcomes.
lanes.baseline: Price-only/price-plus-vol and zero ETF/breadth gates at same UTC knowledge clock.
lanes.falsifier: No stable positive cohort lift or unavailable release-time data falsifies usable edge.

lanes.name: CFGI actual capture and retrospective temporal-contamination test

lanes.question: Do lagged liquidation, OI and funding beat price-vol on independent monthly cohorts?

lanes.falsifier: Nonpositive month-mean lift, Feb OI selection gaps, or source post-publication block promotion.

lanes.name: Warning-to-action-to-delivery and after-cost investment utility
lanes.question: Does an early warning actually change user-available actions before severe drawdown?
lanes.hypothesis: Freeze to actual consumer receipt and executable action has positive after-cost utility.
lanes.baseline: Always-HOLD/no warning, same-clock available action and explicit false alarms.
lanes.falsifier: Missing message-delivery, approved SELL owner, or investable quotes blocks utility inference.
